description: A metallic percussion voice: a ring of Karplus-Strong delay lines is struck by a burst of noise, and the lines exchange energy with their neighbours so the tone rings and beats like struck metal

params.text: Sets how much energy each delay line passes to its neighbours, which is what turns a single pitch into a cluster of beating partials
Attenuverts the temper CV before it is added to the temper knob
Sets how long the ring sustains, from a short click to a long ring
Attenuverts the resonance CV before it is added to the resonance knob
Sets how much noise is stirred into the ring while it is sounding, on top of the striking burst
Attenuverts the noise CV before it is added to the noise knob
Spreads the delay lines' lengths apart, -1 to 1, which detunes the partials away from a single pitch in one direction or the other
Attenuverts the shape CV before it is added to the shape knob
Sets how long the noise burst that strikes the ring lasts, measured in cycles of the current pitch
Attenuverts the impulse CV before it is added to the impulse knob
Drives the ring's output into a clipper, two to twenty-two times before the soft clip
Attenuverts the overdrive CV before it is added to the overdrive knob
Sets the pitch of the delay lines, -4V to 4V against 261.63Hz at 0V
Strikes the ring on each press
Sets the output level of both sides, silence to full

inputs.text: A signal fed into every delay line alongside the noise, which lets the ring be excited by something other than its own burst
Changes the neighbour coupling, scaled by a tenth and added to the temper knob through its attenuverter
Changes the sustain, scaled by a tenth and added to the resonance knob through its attenuverter
Changes the amount of noise stirred in, scaled by a tenth and added to the noise knob through its attenuverter
Changes the detuning of the delay lines, scaled by a tenth and added to the shape knob through its attenuverter
Changes the length of the striking burst, scaled by a tenth and added to the impulse knob through its attenuverter
Changes the drive into the clipper, scaled by a tenth and added to the overdrive knob through its attenuverter
Sets the pitch as a volt per octave, added to the pitch knob; the number of channels here is one of the things that makes the module polyphonic
A rise strikes the ring; it is taken as high above 1V, and the ring is struck again only after the jack falls back below that

outputs.text: The left side of the ring, the delay lines panned across the pair in order
The right side of the ring, the delay lines panned across the pair in order

notes: the module makes no sound until it is struck, by the STRIKE button or a rise at the STRIKE jack
menu: Set Node Count: 4 Nodes, 8 Nodes, 12 Nodes, 16 Nodes — sets how many delay lines the ring holds, which changes both the density of the partials and how much work the module does
Delay effect mode — drops the pitch by four octaves so the delay lines are long enough to be heard as echoes rather than as a pitch, making the module a resonant delay
